title: Exact running time of the shift machine
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $x$, the machine with no work tapes that emits one false bit for each input symbol and then emits $w$ halts after exactly $|x|+|w|+2$ steps on input $x$. Its output is the word consisting of $|x|$ false bits followed by $w$.
replaced:
For every suffix word $w$ and every input $x$, the shift machine for $w$ halts on
input $x$ within $|x| + |w| + 2$ steps, and its output is $|x|$ false bits followed
by $w$.
